onboarding.welcome.title: Welcome to Ideo
onboarding.welcome.description: A short setup — two minutes, and you can skip any of it.
onboarding.welcome.stages: Work in stages: a source image, a style pass, then animation. Each stage keeps its own candidates.
onboarding.welcome.cost: Generations are paid for at fal.ai. Ideo shows an estimate before you spend anything.
onboarding.welcome.browse: You can look around without a key. Only generating needs one.
onboarding.apiKey.title: Connect your fal.ai key
onboarding.apiKey.description: Ideo generates through fal.ai, billed to your own account.
onboarding.apiKey.validated: The key is checked against fal.ai as you save it, so a revoked key is caught here rather than partway through a paid job. The check itself is free, and the key is kept in your system keychain.
onboarding.firstProject.title: Create your first project
onboarding.firstProject.description: A project holds one idea and everything generated for it.
onboarding.firstProject.body: You will pick a name and an aspect ratio. The ratio is locked for the life of the project, because video models are far pickier about it than image models.
preferences.general.replayOnboardingDesc: Run through the welcome steps again, from the beginning.
